# Mindbody Public API v6 connector

Go connector for the Mindbody Public API v6 (fitness/wellness studio management: classes, appointments, clients, sales, staff, sites). Full coverage of the public API, generated from the official OpenAPI spec.

## How to use this connector

One `Client` serves one Mindbody site. Construct it with credentials; all
auth headers and the staff user token are handled automatically:

```go
import (
    "github.com/pax-beehive/connector"
    "github.com/pax-beehive/connector/mindbody"
)

c, err := mindbody.NewClient(&mindbody.Config{
    APIKey:   "...",     // required
    SiteID:   "-99",     // required ("-99" is the Mindbody sandbox site)
    Username: "staff",   // optional staff credentials; most write
    Password: "secret",  // endpoints and some reads require them
})

resp, err := c.GetClasses(ctx, &mindbody.GetClassesRequest{
    Limit:       connector.Ptr(25),
    LocationIds: []int{1},
})
```

## Auth model

- `Api-Key`, `SiteId`, and `Version` headers are attached to every request.
- If `Username`/`Password` are set, a staff user token is issued lazily via
  `POST /usertoken/issue`, cached in memory, and re-issued automatically
  once after a 401. Without staff credentials only public read endpoints
  work; authenticated endpoints return 401.

## Errors

Any non-2xx response is returned as `*connector.APIError` with
`StatusCode`, Mindbody's `Code`/`Message`, and the raw `Body`. Check it
with `errors.As`.

## Data conventions

- Date-time fields use `connector.DateTime`. The wire format has NO
  timezone: values are interpreted in the studio site's local time zone.
  Construct them in site-local time; offsets are dropped on send.
- Optional scalars are pointers (`*int`, `*string`, ...); absent means
  "not sent". Slices encode as repeated query keys.
- IDs and paging: list endpoints take `Limit`/`Offset` and return a
  `PaginationResponse`; there is no automatic pagination helper — loop
  with `Offset` yourself.

## Capability boundaries (what this connector does NOT do)

- No webhooks (Mindbody's Webhooks API is a separate product/spec).
- No rate limiting or retry/backoff beyond the single 401 re-auth retry.
- No request validation: required-ness is enforced by the API server, not
  by these types.

Every operation below is a method on `*mindbody.Client` with the
uniform signature:

```go

```

The request struct carries every input of the HTTP call: path params, query
params, and the request body (flattened into the struct). Optional fields
are pointers (use `connector.Ptr(v)`); slice fields repeat the query key.
Field-level details for an operation live in the `<tag>_gen.go` file next
